items.corrections: An adult-rat electroporation experiment regenerated several listed skin appendages; a separate one-patient human case reported full-thickness functional skin. Neither demonstrates the safe, inducible, complete human regeneration or the forecast impact.
Primary trials show disease control during treatment in atopic dermatitis and some off-treatment psoriasis remission, while many patients relapse. No one-time immune reset or cure was demonstrated.

A small exploratory human trial reported lower p16 and increased collagen VII with topical rapamycin in photoaged skin. It does not show safe, permanent reversal of intrinsic aging, DNA damage or cancer risk.

A phase III trial found a 23% lower nonmelanoma skin-cancer rate during 12 months of nicotinamide in high-risk patients, with no benefit after stopping. It does not support universal, lifelong prevention or melanoma prevention.

A case report describes autologous full-thickness skin regeneration with functional appendages in one wound; a randomized study supports autologous cell suspension plus grafting with less donor skin for acute defects. The compound scalable, lifelong platform is not demonstrated.

In vivo reflectance confocal microscopy assessed basal cell carcinoma margins in a 50-patient feasibility study with high but imperfect sensitivity/specificity. It falls short of single-cell complete excision with no positive margins across skin cancers.

A relevant 2026 randomized withdrawal study was identified, but its opened PubMed record had no abstract and the publisher full text redirected to an inaccessible CDN. Because the primary results could not be read, no claim support is assessed here.

FDA labeling reports topical gene therapy improving durable closure for COL7A1 dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa wounds. This is meaningful indication-specific progress, not systemic universal correction of all mutations with lifelong effect and zero off-target risk.

Trials report narrower wound-healing gains: Dermagraft improved 12-week closure for chronic diabetic foot ulcers, and an autologous construct case showed full-thickness tissue at 12 weeks. These do not establish all-cause complete healing within weeks.

A single-site phase I trial in 26 subjects with male-pattern baldness reported increased hair-growth measures after one HSC injection. It does not establish lifelong growth, unwanted-hair removal or a master molecular switch.
